name: Thunder-Bridge Jotun
loreTies: A mountain-blood giant bound to Aesir border law; enormous, but still beneath Titan scale unless empowered by Gate storm.
Controls elevation and pushes the Titan away from objectives.
source culture humans later copied as Norse myth
shortBackstory: Thunder-Bridge Jotun is a lore-faithful Asgardian run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Thunder-Bridge Jotun belongs to The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds and exists to express Asgardian law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Controls elevation and pushes the Titan away from objectives.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Basalt-blue giant with lightning scars, storm-root manacles, broken bridge stones strapped as armor. Abilities — Storm Boulder, Oath Roar, Bridge Quake — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Titan-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
